rationale: This revised plan incorporates all feedback from the prior execution. The duplicate_check component now includes both the individual 'adherence.member_id' key and the composite 'adherence.member_id+therapeutic_class' key to comprehensively verify uniqueness at different grain levels. The write_report component caveats now include 'synthetic_data' to transparently communicate the synthetic nature of the dataset, and 'sample_preview' to clarify that value samples are previews rather than analytical findings. All other components remain unchanged to maintain the comprehensive dataset reconnaissance approach.
changes_summary: Added 'adherence.member_id' to duplicate_check keys to verify single-column key uniqueness individually. Added 'synthetic_data' and 'sample_preview' caveats to write_report to address communication gaps in prior execution.
